output.summary: A thorny shrub or small tree native to Europe. It has deeply lobed leaves and late-spring white or pink flowers, followed by red haws containing a stone-encased seed. The dry-fleshed haws are commonly made into preserves, syrups or wine, while young leaves and petals are also edible.
output.edibilityNote: Dry-fleshed haws are commonly made into preserves, syrups or wine; young leaves and petals are edible, with petals recorded in a medieval English pottage.
